verdict.rationale: Rippling's own docs describe building custom workflows that fire on events: notifying people of important changes, triggering a bonus reminder, and triggering cross-app workflows such as a Slack alert from a Zendesk ticket. Supergroup rules also automatically adjust app permissions as roles change, and rules defined once are enforced everywhere. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the trigger/condition/action model (available event types, rule syntax, limits), and independent or hands-on corroboration that the workflow engine works as marketed.
